description: Rb₃NaMg(MoO₄)₂ crystallizes in the trigonal P3m1 space group. There are three inequivalent Rb sites. In the first Rb site, Rb is bonded to seven O atoms to form RbO₇ hexagonal pyramids that share corners with six equivalent RbO₇ hexagonal pyramids,  a cornercorner with one MoO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three equivalent MoO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (3.06 Å) and six longer (3.14 Å) Rb-O bond lengths. In the second Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Rb-O bond distances ranging from 3.22-3.34 Å. In the third Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Mg and three equivalent O atoms. The Rb-Mg bond length is 3.02 Å. All Rb-O bond lengths are 2.83 Å. Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.26 Å. Mg is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Rb and three equivalent O atoms. All Mg-O bond lengths are 1.88 Å. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MoO₄ tetrahedra that share edges with three equivalent RbO₇ hexagonal pyramids. There is one shorter (1.83 Å) and three longer (2.02 Å) Mo-O bond lengths. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one RbO₇ hexagonal pyramid. There is one shorter (1.77 Å) and three longer (1.81 Å) Mo-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three Rb, one Mg, and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Rb, one Na, and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Rb and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Rb and one Mo atom.
